title: Bag of bricks- Jungle Green 16
descriptionHtml:
Jungle Green — colour 16

Lush and deep, with a slightly blue lean. Jungle Green builds dense foliage, palm leaves and forest shade — the green you reach for when the scene needs depth rather than freshness.

Works well with: Dark Green 23, Green 22, Olive Green 17

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Jungle Green bricks (colour 16) for Memobrick mosaics. A lush deep green for foliage, forests and tropical backgrounds. Resealable bag.
